title: SCE 1.3 Preventive Probe: Validate IAM Permission Boundary Blocks EC2 Reconnaissance
description: Security Chaos Engineering experiment that validates preventive controls (IAM Permission Boundary and least-privilege policies) effectively block unauthorized EC2 reconnaissance (T1580 - Cloud Infrastructure Discovery). A simulated CI/CD role is granted ec2:DescribeInstances but bounded by a Permission Boundary that explicitly denies EC2 discovery actions. The experiment verifies that the boundary overrides the allow, returning UnauthorizedOperation and preventing disclosure of banking EC2 instance metadata configurations.

steady-state-hypothesis.title: Least-privilege IAM permission boundary blocks EC2 reconnaissance
